# 0.1.1-beta.15.2

Beta.15.2 is a maintenance release on top of 0.1.1-beta.15 for source
installations that follow the documented tag checkout.

## Highlights

- Health reports a detached checkout at an exact release tag as a release
  checkout with its clean or dirty state, and the update check compares against
  the newest published release tag instead of requiring a branch upstream.
- The release evidence gates read the candidate version from `VERSION` and
  allow each gate thirty minutes, so the published validation run matches the
  tagged revision.

## Compatibility

Same baseline as 0.1.1-beta.15: the repository's pinned Omarchy 4.0.3 package
and source baseline, validated on one output at scale 1. Update from
v0.1.1-beta.15 with `git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.1.1-beta.15.2 &&
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes`.

## Notes

- Tag v0.1.1-beta.15.1 was created but never published as a release; its
  changes are included here.
- The notes of 0.1.1-beta.15 remain valid.
- AUR publication remains deferred.
